headline: Small S swell at a workable angle — early is the play before the sea breeze.
today: Better angle here than Rockaway, so the 4-second S actually organizes into a few chest-high sets. Dawn is cross/light and cleanest; the SSW onshore builds by afternoon and blows it out. Fish or log early, don't sleep in.

daysToWatch.note: Best of the week — 2-3ft at a good angle with only light SW cross-on in the morning. Fish or shortboard, get on it before the afternoon onshore.
Similar size but 13mph+ WSW cross all day chops it up.
Cross-off morning but swell fades under 1.5ft — clean and marginal.
